participant_1.name: Polina
participant_1.personality: Caring and nurturing, Polina is focused on her family and is excited about the arrival of her triplets. She is also adapting to a new country and has a strong sense of responsibility.
participant_1.background: I am expecting triplets in three months. I recently moved to this country. I already have stepchildren. I work at a school.
